title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
title_zh: 为覆盖而采集，凭证据回放：面向长程智能体的自适应高效在策略蒸馏
abstract_en: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.
abstract_zh: 全在线在策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation，OPD）的每次更新都依赖新的环境交互轨迹，因此在长程任务上成本较高。前缀回放让当前学生模型基于已存储的交互历史生成响应，既减少等待长尾轨迹的空闲时间，也让单条轨迹支持多次更新。本文发现了两个局限：在采集阶段，仅使用教师轨迹会遗漏学生自身产生的历史，而扩大覆盖范围又可能降低教师响应的可靠性；在复用阶段，按固定位置分配回放无法识别可能出现在任意深度的关键决策。为此，CARE-OPD 让教师从学生生成的历史出发续写轨迹，并通过响应级置信度门控过滤不可靠的更新；随后根据后续执行结果，回溯识别并优先回放影响任务结果的轮次。在 Software Engineering 和 Deep Research 长程任务上，CARE-OPD 均优于在线 OPD 和既有前缀回放基线。在 SWE-bench Verified 上，任务成功率达到 59.5%；相比异步在线 OPD，端到端训练时间缩短 45%，环境动作次数减少 44%。
key_points_zh: 前缀回放将轨迹采集与训练更新解耦，让同一条轨迹支持多次更新，减少等待长尾轨迹的时间。
CARE-OPD 让教师从学生生成的交互历史出发续写轨迹，以覆盖仅靠教师采集容易遗漏的状态，并通过响应级置信度门控过滤不可靠的更新。
回放不再依赖固定的轨迹位置，而是根据后续执行结果，优先选择对任务结果有影响的决策轮次。
CARE-OPD 在 Software Engineering 和 Deep Research 上优于对比基线；在 SWE-bench Verified 上成功率达 59.5%，相较异步在线 OPD，训练时间缩短 45%，环境动作次数减少 44%。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是利用学生智能体轨迹和下游执行反馈改进策略蒸馏：扩展历史覆盖、过滤低置信度更新，并优先回放关键决策。相对异步在线蒸馏，摘要量化报告了成功率与训练成本结果，但未展示各组件的独立作用或适用边界。
